Title: The public preview of Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server is available in two new regions

Body.Content:
The public preview for Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server deployment option is now available in the France Central and Brazil South regions.

With Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server you can enjoy:

  • A simplified provisioning experience
  • Low total cost of ownership with burstable sku and stop/start
  • Better resiliency with zone redundant high availability
  • Improved control with scheduled maintenance
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption
  • Openness of the community version of MySQL

Learn more about regional availability for Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server.
